run_preprocess_relaxed_cli: run the preprocess_relaxed CLI to convert trajectory files into LMDB graph features for S2EF task splits
run_write_images_to_lmdb: run write_images_to_lmdb to read a .traj file, convert atoms to graphs, and write pickled data objects to an LMDB database
run_main_multiprocessing: run main to chunk trajectory files across workers and process each split using a multiprocessing pool
review_AtomsToGraphs_config: review the AtomsToGraphs initialization with max_neigh=50, radius=6, and r_fixed=True for graph feature extraction
refactor_main_split_logic: refactor main to support additional trajectory splits beyond id, ood_ads, ood_cat, and ood_both
